objective: Implement hydragrow-diagnostic-worker binary crate polling Hestia states and watchdog breaches with bounded-concurrency LLM tool-calling loop, device scoping, query clamping, dedup pre-checks, and fallback alerts.

acceptance.criterion: WorkerConfig loads env configuration and applies design spec defaults.
acceptance.verification: Unit tests in config.rs verify loading required keys and applying defaults.

acceptance.criterion: Pure trigger evaluator fires Hestia state and watchdog breach triggers.
acceptance.verification: Unit tests in trigger.rs verify Hestia state and watchdog breach evaluation.

acceptance.criterion: Backend HTTP client implements DiagnosisBackend for fleet checks, breaches, dedup checks, crop targets, and alert writing.
acceptance.verification: Mock tests in backend_client.rs verify API endpoints.

acceptance.criterion: DiagnosticModel trait and parse_diagnosis strictly validate reason codes and confidence bounds with unexplained_anomaly fallback.
acceptance.verification: Unit tests in diagnostic_model.rs verify parsing validation and fallback.

acceptance.criterion: AnthropicDiagnosticModel executes tool calling with token, round trip, and time budgets, enforcing device scoping and query clamping.
acceptance.verification: Unit tests in anthropic_model.rs verify tool dispatch, device scope checking, and budget limits.

acceptance.criterion: Orchestrator run_diagnosis skips model on recent alert dedup and falls back to unexplained_anomaly on model errors.
acceptance.verification: Unit tests in orchestrator.rs verify dedup pre-check and fallback behavior.

acceptance.criterion: Fleet tick run_fleet_tick executes bounded-concurrency diagnoses across triggered fleet devices.
acceptance.verification: Unit test in tick.rs verifies fleet tick execution.
